children: Artificial intelligence infrastructure spending is on track to reach nearly $1.4 trillion in 2027, raising fresh questions about how the industry will finance one of the largest investment cycles in tech history, J.P. Morgan says in a report. JPM estimates public investment-grade markets will supply about $450 billion of financing next year after supporting around $368 billion of bond issuance in 2026. The bank expects debt markets, equity capital and operating cash flows to play increasingly important roles in funding AI data-center expansion as spending growth remains strong, albeit at a slower pace after 2027. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
